description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for Self Service Module (SPM) surveys within the Apache Fineract project. It exposes an endpoint to fetch all active surveys for self-service use, integrating security and conditional module enabling.

classes.name: SelfSpmApiResource
classes.description: REST resource class exposing survey-related endpoints for self-service, secured by the platform security context, conditional on the self-service module being enabled.

methods.name: fetchAllSurveys
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve all active surveys by invoking the SpmApiResource's fetchAllSurveys method after authenticating the user.
